abstractive_summary: The project team brainstormed ideas for a unique, user-friendly remote control, exploring features such as a vibrating or lighting couch remote, and assigned tasks to the marketing and industrial designer teams.
key_decisions: The selling price goal is twenty-five Euro, and the profit aim is fifty million Euro.
The remote control should have a limited number of buttons and possibly a built-in screen.
The remote control should be portable and not require a dedicated base or attachment to the couch.
The remote control should have a robust and water-resistant design to prevent damage and user annoyance.
The project manager decided to focus on user requirements and assigned tasks to the marketing and industrial designer teams.
